text: {"assertions":["An off-by-one error in the slice bound of search/query/rewriter.ts caused empty result sets when searching for two-word phrases containing stop words.","The bug only manifested on the staging read replica and resulted in rewritten queries with no clauses.","The fix involved correcting the slice bound and adding a property test to prevent regression.","PR #1367 on branch fix/empty-result-set-1 resolved the issue and reduced a flaky test's failure rate from 85 per hundred runs to zero.","The search/query/rewriter component is written in TypeScript and tested with search/query/rewriter.test.ts."]}
